findings.comment: Biofiltration pond is located in NE corner near northern 5' P.U.E. easement with overhead electric lines. Pond profile sheets (15-16) do not depict property line, easement boundary, or overhead electric line locations, making it impossible to verify the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead distribution primary/neutral/secondary conductors per UCM § 1.10.3. Cross-referencing site plan (Sheet 9) shows retaining wall appears very close to property line/easement, but exact distances are not dimensioned.

Biofiltration pond clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors cannot be verified. Pond profile sections (Sheets 15-16) do not show property line or overhead electric line locations. Site plan (Sheet 9) shows OHE line along northern property line but retaining wall proximity not dimensioned. Cannot confirm 15-foot radial clearance in all directions per UCM § 1.10.3.

applicableAreas: Biofiltration/detention pond (NE corner), all pond plan/profile sheets
findings.comment: Biofiltration pond is located near electric facilities (5' P.U.E. easement and overhead electric lines at northern property boundary), but engineer-sealed profile plans and section views do not show property line, easement boundary, or overhead electric line locations. Missing required profile plans/elevation views demonstrating clearance verification and dimensions between water quality feature and overhead electric conductors per UCM § 1.10.3.

applicableAreas: Northern and southern property boundaries (5' electric easement areas)
findings.comment: Site plan and landscape plan show concrete retaining walls (particularly at biofiltration pond and along southern boundary) and structures in proximity to property boundaries where 5' electric easements are located. Exact distances between easement boundaries and structures not dimensioned on current plans. Cannot verify whether any structures, footings, or permanent improvements encroach into the 5' easement zones per UCM § 1.10.10.2.

applicableAreas: Northern and southern property boundaries (5' electric easement areas)
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows multiple mitigation trees (labeled M) and sod (H.7) directly overlapping or immediately adjacent to northern and southern property boundaries where 5' electric easements are located. Irrigation notes specify permanent irrigation with drip or bubblers for newly planted trees, but no documentation of executed license agreement obtained from and filed with Austin Energy Public Involvement is referenced in the site plan package. Plans do not demonstrate required license agreement per UCM § 1.10.10.3.

applicableAreas: Northern and southern property boundaries (5' electric easement areas)
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows multiple trees (M), sod (H.7), and planting areas extending to property boundaries within 5' electric easement zones. Site plan shows decomposed granite walkway along northern boundary very close to easement. Cannot verify that proposed landscaping maintains required 24/7 vehicular access for Austin Energy personnel and equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.3, as landscaping/access route layout within easement areas not clearly depicted.

Site plan (Sheet 9) shows wood fence labeled near southeastern corner property boundary where 5' electric easement exists. Fencing detail type (removable vs. permanent, material specification) not shown on current plans. Cannot verify whether fencing is removable wooden fence (allowed under license agreement) or non-removable/permanent type that would prevent Austin Energy crew and equipment access per UCM § 1.10.10.2.

applicableAreas: Northern and southern property boundaries (5' electric easement areas)
findings.comment: Site plan and landscape plan show various site features (trees, retaining walls, walkways, signage, mail kiosk) located at or very near property boundaries where 5' electric easements are located. Exact distances from easement boundaries to site amenities not dimensioned. Cannot definitively verify that all site amenities are outside easement areas per UCM § 1.10.10.2.
